whatIsAI.title: AI Sachmuch Kya Hai?
whatIsAI.definition: Artificial Intelligence koi jaadu ya soochne wala praani nahi hai. Yeh ek powerful tool hai jo bade data mein patterns dhundta hai.
whatIsAI.analogyText: AI ko sikhana ek bachche ko 'kutta' kya hai sikhane jaise hai. Tum usse biology ki kitaab nahi dete. Tum usse hazaron kutto ki tasweerein dikhate ho jab tak uska dimagh khud-ba-khud pattern ko samajh na le!
whatIsAI.point1: AI examples se seekhta hai, pehle se likhe rules se nahi
whatIsAI.point2: Yeh aisse patterns dhundta hai jo manushya chhod sakte hain
whatIsAI.point3: Recommendations, Voice Assistants Aur Maps Mein Roz Ka Upyog
